# Plugin.Maui.LocalStore

Room-style app-document facade for .NET MAUI. One collection API (`IStoreCollection<T>`). 1.0 opens SQLite, NuvexaDB, Realm, LiteDB, DuckDB, SQLCipher, Firebird, LMDB, RocksDB, and LevelDB. Switching backends does not migrate data. DuckDB, Firebird, RocksDB, and LevelDB use managed JSON files when the native library is missing.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.LocalStore
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.LocalStore
Paper: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-local-store/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT
Version: 1.0.1

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+), net10.0-maccatalyst (15+), net10.0-windows (10.0.17763+; packed on Windows)

Platforms: Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst, and Windows. The Windows TFM is included when the package is packed on Windows. Not every engine has natives on every OS — DuckDB / Firebird / RocksDB / LevelDB use JSON files on mobile; LMDB uses JSON on Mac Catalyst. See README platform table.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.LocalStore

Registration: `UseMauiLocalStore` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- Room-style local database in .NET MAUI
- Switch between SQLite, NuvexaDB, Realm, LiteDB, DuckDB, SQLCipher, Firebird, LMDB, RocksDB, and LevelDB with one DAO
- IStoreCollection / StoreFilter for app documents

## Do not use when

- You need durable jobs — that is Plugin.Maui.JobQueue
- You need offline sync — that is Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync
- You only want Nuvexa — use Nuventra.NuvexaDB directly
